profiles: legacy synchronous stdio/TCP replay, validate, trace generation and explorer
opt-in TLS1.3 mTLS and optional registry pins

rules.note: All built-in transports delimit lines with LF, reject empty/unterminated input and strict-decode UTF-8; replay codec requires object proto_step.
Outbound raw UTF-8 payload checked at 65535; stdio bounded byte reads; TCP/TLS shared accumulator bounded plus at most fixed 4096-byte read.
Dispatch on string proto_step and read selected keys, ignoring unknown outer keys; stricter MI objects handled separately.
Replay/explorer/validate start with register; jobs query without registration on network-only Connection. Stdio refuses Connection adoption.

Replay/explorer/validate terminal paths close; job submission register_error ends its attempt while retaining Connection. Guide section 10 and server dispatchAsync permit that async attempt interpretation, despite broad C5 wording.

Owned replay transports close on success/failure; persistent Connection has serialized idempotent close; EOF poisons async connections. Job eviction is server behavior; source tests cover cross-owner lifetime.
No protocol heartbeat or idle timer. TLS timeout cleared after handshake. queryJob available for polling.
Shared replay invokes computer once then sends one report_state for initial_state and next_step.
State.toJson encodes every supplied field as ITF; full observable-state honesty/completeness remains caller binding obligation.
step_mismatch returns error immediately; main owner closes, without expecting all_steps_done.
Arbitrary precision Int encodes as decimal #bigint and integral bare JSON is accepted.
Replay loops until actual terminal reply, no assumed trace length.

Closure resolver recursively handles EXTENDS/INSTANCE and errors on ambiguity, but comment stripping ignores quoted strings: a string containing (* before a later INSTANCE can hide required dependency.

Typed outbound config omits absent optionals and is conforming. Public ApalacheConfig.ofJson? rejects explicit null optional fields; this affects convenience request decoding, not normal typed runner emission.
constInit and paramVars encode unchanged when supplied; applications must set constInit for CONSTANTS specs.
Sync and async helpers reject bounds outside [1,100] before writes.
Job IDs are plain opaque strings queryable on independent Connections; source live test reverse-awaits different submitter jobs.
await sends optional timeout unchanged and returns status/result, including terminal replies; no hidden timeout/error conversion.
cancelJob explicitly issues cancel_job and returns server result; process termination is server responsibility.
Async validate outcome decodes through same ValidateResult.ofJson? as sync registration.
unknown phase is returned directly to caller; library contains no automatic retry loop.
No implicit pool; caller sizes connection use. queue-full register_error surfaced as registerFailed, no retry.
No cross-connection ordering assumption; jobs correlated exactly by requested jobId and submission kind.
Opt-in native shim fixes min/max TLS1.3, loads client chain/key, checks key pairing and verifies CA.
Normal nonempty hostname/IP selects SAN-only validation, but public serverName=some empty string reaches C branch that entirely skips SAN identity setup.
Configured direct/registry pin compared case-insensitively before returning Transport; mismatches close. Registry pin is optional in ServiceInfo, so deployments requiring pins must supply them.
POSIX group/other permissions fail before network; owner-only modes such as 0400 are accepted (safe but literal exact-0600 wording is broader than actual policy). OpenSSL supplies wildcard matching.
Legacy StateComputer/MirrorError remain separate; only additive negotiated register/register_traces encode extension.
Metadata inert; no descriptor interpreter/load/retrieve APIs. Trusted compiled binding receives model state, app port projection belongs generated binding.
GeneratedMetadata embeds digest and normalized contract; runtime validates static metadata and exact-key factory. Compiler-owned generated sources must remain unedited in consumer builds.
Target/computer contract validated before transport; returned binding assertCompatibleConfig checked before replay callbacks.
Bounded duplicate-aware parser, canonical digest parser, strict allowed/required keys and bounded closed companion contracts.
Registration sends complete contract under inline, no path inference or digest reference.
Contract and digest drawn from single generated metadata selection; returned exact digest rechecked. Provenance/model name cannot substitute identity.
Pure preparation before transport; admitMatched precedes sole withBinding factory path; malformed/missing/denied/wrong digest constructs nothing.
Only matched with supported schema and exact canonical digest; non-null descriptor/descriptorBytes forbidden.
Lean advertises required verification only; no prefer or fallback API and no silent downgrade.
Immutable array exact four-part BEq key, ambiguity rejects; no range/latest/closest matching.
Factory called once after matched; runner rechecks digest/config before replay. Returning truly fresh application resources remains factory contract.
Legacy and negotiated share Internal.replay; successful acquisition always scopes single dispose; primary failure wins over disposal/close errors.
Separate NegotiatedError server registration, local model-interface and legacy carriers; stable local codes preserved.
No dynamic descriptor interpreter/cache profile advertised; strict verify rejects descriptor payload.

findings.trigger: Call connectMirrorTls with cfg.serverName := some "" against a CA-valid peer whose SAN does not match the intended host.
findings.impact: Client skips server hostname/IP authentication and trusts any CA-valid server certificate unless an independent matching pin is also configured.
findings.fix: Reject an empty effective server name in Lean before native connect and defensively reject it in the C shim. Add wrong-SAN peer + empty override regression.

findings.trigger: Valid TLA+ source contains a string literal "(*" before a subsequent Helper == INSTANCE Dep statement.
findings.impact: stripComments enters block-comment depth inside the quoted string and discards later dependency tokens; inline registration omits Dep source and fails remotely.
findings.confidence: high source-confirmed; actual Lean runtime probe pending
findings.fix: Lex and preserve/skip quoted strings while stripping comments; add fixture with comment delimiters inside strings before an INSTANCE reference.

additionalObservations.trigger: Public ApalacheConfig.ofJson? receives explicit null optionals such as constInit:null.
additionalObservations.impact: Convenience decoder rejects a valid Haskell-style request config; typed outgoing runners omit keys and remain conforming.
additionalObservations.confidence: high source-confirmed, peripheral to advertised client receive path
additionalObservations.fix: Make optional/default accessors treat explicit null as absent; test null and absent equivalence.

testEvidence.scope: framing UTF-8 boundary, normal/mismatch replay, recursive closure, TCP loopback; inspected, not run
shared async vectors, wrong IDs/kind, framing failure, EOF/close, optional live cross-owner/cancel; inspected, not run
admission negatives zero factories, lifecycle primary/disposal failure, registry and bounds, native codecs; inspected, not run
TLS normal, CA/pin/SAN/CN/permissions/TLS1.2 failures and close; inspected, not run

limits: No local compilation, tests, modelchecker or source edits performed.
No current-revision runtime qualification inferred from old acceptance records.
C25 and C13 findings are source-confirmed; bounded remote WSL probes are recommended before describing them as runtime reproduced.
Application-observer fidelity, CONSTANTS constInit selection, pool sizing, build-generated identity provenance and truly fresh factories require consumer/application evidence.

Async register_error is interpreted as terminal for the submit attempt per guide section10 and actual Mirrors dispatchAsync; broad C5 wording should be clarified if strict connection-terminal semantics are intended.
SO12 exists in current guide and was also classified N/A.
